import itertools
def diff_summary():
    a = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

    return changed
for act in ['LEFT','UP','DOWN']:

    ch = diff_summary()
    print(act, "board_changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), "cells:", len(ch), ch[:12])
